integrity: An exact standalone integer computation over two choices of reduced Laplacian and two normal-form routes accompanies the proof; not an external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only characteristic at least seven and the specified six-coordinate Frobenius twists; the graph critical group is not an algebraic variety's Picard or Jacobian group. Historical priority is provisional; no independent review.
title: Frobenius-fixed critical groups of the Cremona–Richmond incidence graph
